Under t2-i9 the FOI exemption is upheld after internal review and further enquiries are redirected to a public information session nine weeks out. The escalation is absorbed into scheduled process before it gains an audience.

life_path.event: Subject files a formal appeal against the s.31 exemption with the information regulator. Courteous, prompt, non-substantive replies under t1-i10 and an unchanged Carnegie service rhythm erode the urgency of her complaint, pushing the filing back by several months.

life_path.event: The engagement to Callum Shore dissolves. The confidentiality schedule on the data-sharing agreement prevents him from answering her question, and the wedding booking has already been cancelled. The couple separate and she relocates within Mercer Row.
life_path.headline: Engagement Dissolved

life_path.event: Subject seeks a post outside Stillwater. Under t3-i1 her discretionary hours are committed to 'Stillwater Remembers' session preparation and her leave cover has been declined, so a sustained absence or out-of-city move cannot be arranged without notice. The relocation is deferred indefinitely.
life_path.headline: Relocation Deferred

life_path.event: Subject is retained as Senior Librarian and lead of the 'Stillwater Remembers' programme. Her inquiry is channelled into sanctioned local-history work, and her relationships with Dorothy Pryce and Mia Marsh keep her anchored to the branch.
life_path.headline: Retained in Post

life_path.event: Subject maintains a low-signal offline practice: cash spending, paper notebooks and a powered-down handset. Her Archive trail thins, and modelled confidence in her later path degrades accordingly.
life_path.headline: Persistent Data Opacity

life_path.event: Death in late life, cause undetermined owing to a sparse medical record. Projection rests on population baseline only.
life_path.headline: Natural Death
